title: VoiceToken
description:
A LiveKit join token for one person and one plan room. `expires_at` bounds the join only:
LiveKit refreshes the token of a connected participant (ADR 0073).

identity.description: `<login>#<suffix>`, so two tabs of one person do not evict each other.

room.description: The LiveKit room: `rubato-` and 32 hex digits of the plan room's key.
